questions.question: The curved surface area and the volume of a cylinder are 792 cm² and 2772cm³ respectively. What is the ratio of its radius to height? (Take pi = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Curved surface area = 792 cm²

Volume = 2772 cm³

π = 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × r × h = 792

⇒ (44 ÷ 7) × r × h = 792

⇒ r × h = 792 × 7 ÷ 44

⇒ r × h = 126

⇒ πr²h = 2772

⇒ (22 ÷ 7) × r² × h = 2772

⇒ r²h = 2772 × 7 ÷ 22

⇒ r²h = 882

⇒ (r²h) ÷ (rh) = 882 ÷ 126

⇒ r = 7

⇒ rh = 126

⇒ 7h = 126

⇒ h = 18

⇒ Ratio r : h = 7 : 18

**∴ The correct answer is 7 : 18.**

questions.question: A truck covers a distance of 384 km at a certain speed. If the speed is decreased by 16 km/h, it would have taken 2 hours more to cover the same distance. The original speed (in km/h) of the truck is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 384 km

Decrease in speed = 16 km/h

Additional time = 2 hours

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

(Speed - Decrease in speed) × Additional time = Distance

**Calculation:**

Let original speed = x km/h.

Time at original speed ⇒ 384 / x

Time at reduced speed ⇒ 384 / (x - 16)

Additional time ⇒ (384 / (x - 16)) - (384 / x) = 2

⇒ 384 / (x - 16) - 384 / x = 2

⇒ (384x - 384(x - 16)) / x(x - 16) = 2

⇒ (384 × 16) / x(x - 16) = 2

⇒ 6144 = 2x(x - 16)

⇒ 6144 = 2x² - 32x

⇒ 2x² - 32x - 6144 = 0

⇒ x² - 16x - 3072 = 0

Solving quadratic equation:

⇒ (x - 64)(x + 48) = 0

⇒ x = 64 or x = -48

Since speed cannot be negative, so, x = 64.

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

questions.question: If 67% of a number is added to 59.4, then the result is the number itself. The number is:If 67% of a number is added to 59.4, then the result is the number itself. The number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

67% of a number is added to 59.4 gives the number itself

**Concept Used:**

67% of N = 67 ÷ 100 × N

Equation: (67 ÷ 100 × N) + 59.4 = N

**Calculation:**

⇒ 0.67N + 59.4 = N

⇒ N − 0.67N = 59.4

⇒ 0.33N = 59.4

⇒ N = 59.4 ÷ 0.33

⇒ N = 180

**∴ The correct answer is 180.**

questions.question: A bought an article for ₹5,200 and sold it at a loss of 30%. With this amount, he bought another article and sold it at a gain of 60%. What was his overall gain?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of first article = 5200

Loss on first article = 30%

Gain on second article = 60%

**Concept Used:**

Selling price after loss = CP × (1 − loss ÷ 100)

Selling price after gain = CP × (1 + gain ÷ 100)

Overall gain % = (Net gain ÷ Initial CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP of first article = 5200 × (1 − 30 ÷ 100)

⇒ SP = 5200 × 0.70

⇒ SP = 3640

⇒ This 3640 becomes new CP

⇒ SP of second article = 3640 × (1 + 60 ÷ 100)

⇒ SP = 3640 × 1.60

⇒ SP = 5824

⇒ Net gain = 5824 − 5200

⇒ Net gain = 624

⇒ Overall gain % = 624 ÷ 5200 × 100

⇒ Overall gain % = 12%

**∴ The correct answer is 12%.**

questions.question: The smallest number of five digits that is divisible by 5, 35, 39 and 65 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Divisors: 5, 35, 39, 65

Smallest five-digit number: 10000

**Formula Used:**

Least Common Multiple (LCM): Smallest number divisible by all given divisors.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Prime factorization:

5 = 5

35 = 5 × 7

39 = 3 × 13

65 = 5 × 13

⇒ LCM = 5 × 7 × 3 × 13 = 1365

⇒ Find the smallest five-digit number divisible by 1365:

10000 ÷ 1365 = 7.32 (approx.)

⇒ Next integer = 8

⇒ 1365 × 8 = 10920

**∴ The correct answer is 10920.**

questions.question: The floor of a rectangular room has an area of 60 m² and its perimeter is 34 metres. The length of the longest stick, in metres, which can be put in this rectangular room is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of the room = 60 m²

Perimeter of the room = 34 m

**Formula Used:**

Area = length × breadth

Perimeter = 2 × (length + breadth)

Length of the longest stick = √(length² + breadth²)

**Calculation:**

Let the length = l and breadth = b.

From the perimeter formula: 2 × (l + b) = 34

⇒ l + b = 17 …(1)

From the area formula: l × b = 60 …(2)

From equations (1) and (2), we solve for l and b:

Let l = 17 - b (from equation (1))

Substitute in equation (2):

⇒ (17 - b) × b = 60

⇒ 17b - b² = 60

⇒ b² - 17b + 60 = 0

Factorize: (b - 12)(b - 5) = 0

⇒ b = 12 or b = 5

If b = 12, then l = 5; if b = 5, then l = 12.

Length = 12 m, Breadth = 5 m

Length of the longest stick = √(l² + b²)

⇒ √(12² + 5²)

⇒ √(144 + 25)

⇒ √169

⇒ 13 m

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

questions.question: A sum of 800 becomes ₹956 in 3 years at a certain rate of simple interest at x% p.a. If the rate of interest is increased to (x+6)%, what amount (in) will 800 become in 3 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = 800

Amount after 3 years = 956

Time = 3 years

Rate = x% p.a.

**Concept Used:**

Simple interest = Amount − Principal

Simple interest = P × R × T ÷ 100

New rate = x + 6

**Calculation:**

⇒ Simple interest = 956 − 800

⇒ Simple interest = 156

⇒ 800 × x × 3 ÷ 100 = 156

⇒ 24x = 156

⇒ x = 6.5

⇒ New rate = x + 6 = 6.5 + 6 = 12.5%

⇒ New simple interest = 800 × 12.5 × 3 ÷ 100

⇒ New simple interest = 800 × 0.375

⇒ New simple interest = 300

⇒ New amount = 800 + 300

⇒ New amount = 1100

**∴ The correct answer is 1100.**

questions.question:
What would be the maximum value of Q in the following equation?

5P9+3R7+3Q8 = 1194
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5P9 + 3R7 + 3Q8 = 1194

We want the maximum value of Q

**Formula Used:**

Treat each as a 3-digit number: 5P9 = 500 + 10P + 9

Sum of all terms = 1194

**Calculation:**

⇒ 5P9 = 509 + 10P

⇒ 3R7 = 307 + 10R

⇒ 3Q8 = 308 + 10Q

⇒ (509 + 10P) + (307 + 10R) + (308 + 10Q) = 1194

⇒ 509 + 307 + 308 + 10P + 10R + 10Q = 1194

⇒ 1124 + 10(P + R + Q) = 1194

⇒ 10(P + R + Q) = 1194 − 1124

⇒ 10(P + R + Q) = 70

⇒ P + R + Q = 7

⇒ To maximize Q, minimize P and R

⇒ Minimum digits for P and R = 0

⇒ Q = 7 − (0 + 0)

⇒ Q = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

questions.question: Two numbers are less than a third number by 29% and 37%, respectively. By what percentage is the second muniber less than the first (correct to two decimal places/?
questions.solution:

First number is 29% less than the third number.

Second number is 37% less than the third number.

**Concept Used:**

Take the third number as 100 for simplicity.

Percentage less = (Difference ÷ First number) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ First number = 100 − 29 = 71

⇒ Second number = 100 − 37 = 63

⇒ Difference = 71 − 63 = 8

⇒ Percentage less = 8 ÷ 71 × 100

⇒ Percentage less = 11.2676…

⇒ Percentage less ≈ 11.27%

**∴ The correct answer is 11.27%.**

questions.question: Five years ago, the ratio of the ages of A and B was 4: 5. Seven years hence, the ratio of the ages of A and B will be 11:13. What is the sum of their present ages, in years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Five years ago, the ratio of ages of A and B = 4 : 5

Seven years hence, the ratio of ages of A and B = 11 : 13

**Concept Used:**

Use ratio values with a variable to represent ages in the past.

Add or subtract years as required and form an equation.

**Calculation:**

Let the ages of A and B, 5 years ago = 4x and 5x

⇒ Present age of A = 4x + 5

⇒ Present age of B = 5x + 5

Seven years hence, the ratio becomes 11 : 13

⇒ (4x + 5 + 7) / (5x + 5 + 7) = 11 / 13

⇒ (4x + 12) / (5x + 12) = 11 / 13

⇒ 13(4x + 12) = 11(5x + 12)

⇒ 52x + 156 = 55x + 132

⇒ 156 − 132 = 55x − 52x

⇒ 24 = 3x

⇒ x = 8

⇒ Present age of A = 4 × 8 + 5 = 37

⇒ Present age of B = 5 × 8 + 5 = 45

⇒ Sum of present ages = 37 + 45 = 82

**∴ The correct answer is 82.**

questions.question: The ratio of the efficiencies of A, B and C to do a certain work is 2:3: 5. Working together, they can complete the work in 27 days. A and B worked together for 15 days. In how many days will the remaining work be completed by C alone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of efficiencies of A, B, and C = 2:3:5

Time taken by A, B, and C together to complete the work = 27 days

A and B worked together for 15 days

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

Remaining work = Total work - Work done

Time = Work / Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Efficiency ratio sum = 2 + 3 + 5 = 10 units/day

⇒ Total work = 10 × 27 = 270 units

Efficiency of A + B = 2 + 3 = 5 units/day

⇒ Work done by A and B in 15 days = 5 × 15 = 75 units

⇒ Remaining work = 270 − 75 = 195 units

Efficiency of C = 5 units/day

⇒ Days required by C alone = 195 ÷ 5 = 39 days

**∴ The correct answer is 39 days.**

questions.question: The average monthly expenditure of a family was 2.500 during the first three months. 2.650 during the next four months, and 22.840 during the last five months of a year. If the total savings during the year were ₹12,700, then the average mouthly income (in) of the family was.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average monthly expenditure during the first three months = ₹2,500

Average monthly expenditure during the next four months = ₹2,650

Average monthly expenditure during the last five months = ₹2,840

Total savings during the year = ₹12,700

**Formula Used:**

Total expenditure = (Average expenditure for first three months × 3) + (Average expenditure for next four months × 4) + (Average expenditure for last five months × 5)

Total income = Total expenditure + Total savings

Average monthly income = Total income / 12

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total expenditure = (2,500 × 3) + (2,650 × 4) + (2,840 × 5)

⇒ Total expenditure = 7,500 + 10,600 + 14,200

⇒ Total expenditure = ₹32,300

⇒ Total income = Total expenditure + Total savings

⇒ Total income = 32,300 + 12,700

⇒ Total income = ₹45,000

⇒ Average monthly income = Total income / 12

⇒ Average monthly income = 45,000 / 12

⇒ Average monthly income = ₹3,750

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,750.**
